api_key.description: API key for ArubaCloud. Can also be set via ARUBACLOUD_API_KEY environment variable.

api_secret.description: API secret for ArubaCloud. Can also be set via ARUBACLOUD_API_SECRET environment variable.

base_url.description: (Optional) Override the ArubaCloud API base URL (advanced use only).

resource_timeout.description: Timeout for waiting for resources to become active after creation (e.g., "5m", "10m", "15m"). This timeout applies to all resources that need to wait for active state. Default: "10m"

token_issuer_url.description: (Optional) Override the ArubaCloud token issuer URL (advanced use only).

bootable.description: Whether the block storage is bootable. Must be set to true along with image to create a bootable disk.

image.description: Image ID for bootable block storage. Required when bootable is true. See [available images](https://api.arubacloud.com/docs/metadata/#cloud-server-bootvolume) for a list of supported image IDs.

zone.description: Zone where blockstorage will be created. If not specified, the block storage will be regional (available across all zones in the location). If specified, the block storage will be zonal (tied to a specific zone).
